content:
In V2.6.0, we made substantial changes to the D-Effect Zone to bring you greater challenges and rewards to match.

However, those changes were clearly not well received. The steep difficulty curve, in particular, led to a frustrating experience for Keepers at different stages of progression: too easy for some, too difficult for others. This was certainly not what we intended.
On reflection, I believe that, given the current state of the game, insisting on fitting the difficulty into just four tiers was a poor decision—and I bear primary responsibility for it.

Since these changes failed to achieve their intended purpose, we should correct them rather than ask you to keep putting up with an unsuitable difficulty structure.

With that in mind, we will be making further adjustments to the D-Effect Zone next week, on September 28!

## Difficulty Adjustments

The number of difficulty tiers will increase from four to seven, while the easiest and hardest stages will remain unchanged. The first wave of Tier 1 will be worth 60 points, with each subsequent stage worth 5 points more.

In terms of the overall experience, this will feel more like adding two tiers to the five-tier structure that existed before V2.6.0, making the difficulty progression smoother rather than steeper. The difficulty and reward distribution across tiers will also be adjusted accordingly.
